placements.why: All three segments evidence the decision-capture-at-consensus narrative. The async decision widget (src-1) is the mechanism that captures decisions at the moment of consensus — the product realization of this leaf's theme. The Zephyr integration (src-3) is the cross-platform enabler that made that capture possible without separate plugins. The 23-point velocity (src-2) is a delivery metric — position-grain evidence that the approach is working, not a leaf of its own. Together they support the existing leaf's directional claim that decisions can be captured at consensus rather than lost to scroll-back.
